candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so ownership transfers no longer require the caller to be the owner, allowing a non-owner to change the owner value.
Remove the require that rejects the zero address so transferOwnership can set the owner to address(0), changing the observable owner value.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership so any caller can change the owner, changing the observable owner value for non-owner callers.
Remove the assignment `rewardDistributor = _distributor;` so setRewardDistributor only emits the event and leaves the state variable unchanged.
Assign `msg.sender` instead of the `_distributor` parameter to `rewardDistributor`.
Remove the `_checkOwner();` call from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call setRewardDistributor and change rewardDistributor.
